properties.name: Calangute North Safe Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-monitored swim zone near the main Calangute beach entrance / Beach Road junction. Marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags roughly 100m apart.

properties.name: Calangute South Safe Zone
properties.description: Approximate lifeguard-monitored swim zone toward the southern stretch of Calangute beach, closer to the Candolim border. Marked in reality by red-and-yellow flags roughly 100m apart.
